rows.speaker: Yuratei
rows.body: The time has come for our Hau Dragon to rise again!
lines: Yuratei「The time has come for our Hau Dragon to
rise again!」

rows.speaker: Yuratei
rows.body: Now Hau Dragon shall muster all its might and turn the world into the underworld... And I, Yuratei, shall become its ruler... the Lord of Hades!
lines: Yuratei「Now Hau Dragon shall muster all its might
and turn the world into the underworld... And I,
Yuratei, shall become its ruler... the Lord of Hades!」

rows.speaker: Giso
rows.body: The vile criminal who stole Zeorymer of the Heavens from Hau Dragon fifteen years ago and destroyed the fortress's central core!
lines: Giso「The vile criminal who stole Zeorymer of the
Heavens from Hau Dragon fifteen years ago and
destroyed the fortress's central core!」

rows.speaker: Yuratei
rows.body: Mighty Hakkeshu, the pride of Hau Dragon! Who among you will undertake this mission...!?
lines: Yuratei「Mighty Hakkeshu, the pride of Hau Dragon!
Who among you will undertake this mission...!?」

rows.speaker: Taiha
rows.body: Lanstar of the Winds shall bring Hau Dragon its first victory.
lines: Taiha「Lanstar of the Winds shall bring Hau Dragon
its first victory.」

rows.speaker: Taiha
rows.body: You want me to prove myself a man worthy of loving the leader of Hau Dragon... Is that what you mean?
lines: Taiha「You want me to prove myself a man worthy
of loving the leader of Hau Dragon... Is that what
you mean?」

rows.speaker: Yuratei
rows.body: I am the Empress of Hau Dragon... I could not single you out and tell you to come back alive...
lines: Yuratei （I am the Empress of Hau Dragon... I could
not single you out and tell you to come back alive...）

rows.speaker: Miku
rows.body: Yes. It is another name for the secret society Hau Dragon.
lines: Miku「Yes. It is another name for the secret society
Hau Dragon.」

rows.speaker: Masato
rows.body: A secret society... Hau Dragon...?
lines: Masato「A secret society... Hau Dragon...?」

rows.speaker: Taiha
rows.body: Watch me, Yuratei. I'll prove to you who the greatest warrior among Hau Dragon's Hakkeshu is...!
lines: Taiha （Watch me, Yuratei. I'll prove to you who the
greatest warrior among Hau Dragon's Hakkeshu

rows.speaker: Yuratei
rows.body: ...Before I was chosen as Empress of Hau Dragon, I too was one of the Hakkeshu...
lines: Yuratei「...Before I was chosen as Empress of Hau
Dragon, I too was one of the Hakkeshu...」

rows.speaker: Yuratei
rows.body: That "Heaven" is the key to our Hau Dragon's cherished ambition, the "Hades Project"! You must bring it back!
lines: Yuratei「That "Heaven" is the key to our Hau
Dragon's cherished ambition, the "Hades Project"!
You must bring it back!」

rows.speaker: Saiga
rows.body: It concerns measures against those besides Zeorymer of the Heavens who might stand in the way of our Hau Dragon.
lines: Saiga「It concerns measures against those besides
Zeorymer of the Heavens who might stand in the
way of our Hau Dragon.」

rows.speaker: Miku
rows.body: Oki told you about the Iron Dragon... Hau Dragon, didn't he?
lines: Miku「Oki told you about the Iron Dragon... Hau
Dragon, didn't he?」

rows.speaker: Shi-Tau
rows.body: What nonsense... Hau Dragon shall rule the world... We have no need of allies!
lines: Shi-Tau「What nonsense... Hau Dragon shall rule the
world... We have no need of allies!」

rows.speaker: Haruka
rows.body: But on the Yangtze route, Hau Dragon may target us. Their headquarters are said to be in southern China.
lines: Haruka「But on the Yangtze route, Hau Dragon may
target us. Their headquarters are said to be in
southern China.」

rows.speaker: Dr. Plato
rows.body: the Hau Dragon with its special machines, Dolems, Angels and the like would be difficult.
lines: Dr. Plato「the Hau Dragon with its special machines,
Dolems, Angels and the like would be difficult.」

rows.speaker: Kaine
rows.body: We'll never be able to live in peace as long as the likes of Giganos, Hau Dragon and Gulfer are around!
lines: Kaine「We'll never be able to live in peace as long as
the likes of Giganos, Hau Dragon and Gulfer are
around!」

rows.speaker: Prospector
rows.body: Giganos, Gulfer, the Mu... The Hyakki Empire and Hau Dragon... Plus the Vegan Empire, and the Angels on top of that.
lines: Prospector「Giganos, Gulfer, the Mu... The Hyakki
Empire and Hau Dragon... Plus the Vegan Empire, and
the Angels on top of that.」

rows.speaker: Shi-Aen
rows.body: You are in the presence of Hau Dragon's leader. Restrain yourself.
lines: Shi-Aen「You are in the presence of Hau Dragon's
leader. Restrain yourself.」

rows.speaker: Masato
rows.body: Hau Dragon?! Its leader?!
lines: Masato「Hau Dragon?! Its leader?!」

rows.speaker: Yuratei
rows.body: That is the greatest crime of all against us of Hau Dragon!
lines: Yuratei「That is the greatest crime of all against us
of Hau Dragon!」

rows.speaker: Yuratei
rows.body: We of Hau Dragon were planning to assemble an army of giant robots to conquer the world... That was fifteen years ago now.
lines: Yuratei「We of Hau Dragon were planning to
assemble an army of giant robots to conquer the
world... That was fifteen years ago now.」

rows.speaker: Yuratei
rows.body: And the man named Masaki Kihara, who built Zeorymer for Hau Dragon...
lines: Yuratei「And the man named Masaki Kihara, who
built Zeorymer for Hau Dragon...」

rows.speaker: Misato
rows.body: Yes. That one was stolen from Hau Dragon. By one particular man.
lines: Misato「Yes. That one was stolen from Hau Dragon.
By one particular man.」

rows.speaker: Yuratei
rows.body: Zeorymer of the Heavens has now become a calamity for our Hau Dragon!
lines: Yuratei「Zeorymer of the Heavens has now become
a calamity for our Hau Dragon!」

rows.speaker: Hidler
rows.body: Neither Mu nor Hau Dragon has made any notable moves.
lines: Hidler「Neither Mu nor Hau Dragon has made any
notable moves.」

rows.speaker: Miku
rows.body: To stop the Iron Dragon... Hau Dragon's ambitions.
lines: Miku「To stop the Iron Dragon... Hau Dragon's
ambitions.」

rows.speaker: Yuratei
rows.body: We must also prepare for the Hades Project, the cherished ambition of our Hau Dragon... We shall watch and wait for a while.
lines: Yuratei「We must also prepare for the Hades Project,
the cherished ambition of our Hau Dragon... We shall
watch and wait for a while.」

rows.speaker: Yuratei
rows.body: I will not tolerate their existence. When the time is ripe, I shall mobilize all of Hau Dragon's might and obliterate them without fail...!
lines: Yuratei （I will not tolerate their existence. When the
time is ripe, I shall mobilize all of Hau Dragon's might
and obliterate them without fail...!）

rows.speaker: Saiga
rows.body: That would save us in Hau Dragon a great deal of trouble. Quite convenient, really.
lines: Saiga「That would save us in Hau Dragon a great
deal of trouble. Quite convenient, really.」

rows.speaker: Rockfell
rows.body: At present, the forces that clearly stand in our Hau Dragon's way are...
lines: Rockfell「At present, the forces that clearly stand in
our Hau Dragon's way are...」

rows.speaker: Yuratei
rows.body: ...For my Hau Dragon, the foremost enemy is Zeorymer of the Heavens...
lines: Yuratei「...For my Hau Dragon, the foremost enemy
is Zeorymer of the Heavens...」

rows.speaker: Luhran
rows.body: Otherwise, I would never have brought him to this Hau Dragon fortress.
lines: Luhran「Otherwise, I would never have brought him to
this Hau Dragon fortress.」

rows.speaker: Luhran
rows.body: Then you could attack #部隊名 on your own. Why did you approach us, the Hau Dragon?
lines: Luhran「Then you could attack #部隊名
on your own. Why did you approach us, the Hau
Dragon?」

rows.speaker: Luhran
rows.body: Ugh...! Y-yes, the Hau Dragon Fortress was restored by adapting some of your technology.
lines: Luhran「Ugh...! Y-yes, the Hau Dragon Fortress was
restored by adapting some of your technology.」

rows.speaker: Hokushin
rows.body: ...Now I know the exact location of the Hau Dragon Fortress. All that remains is...
lines: Hokushin （...Now I know the exact location of the
Hau Dragon Fortress. All that remains is...）

rows.speaker: Fuyutsuki
rows.body: I never expected Hau Dragon to target this place. Do they intend this as a preliminary battle...?
lines: Fuyutsuki「I never expected Hau Dragon to target this
place. Do they intend this as a preliminary battle...?」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.body: You would burn down a city for that...! Hau Dragon... It seems this organization is even more dangerous than I expected...!
lines: Quattro「You would burn down a city for that...! Hau
Dragon... It seems this organization is even more
dangerous than I expected...!」

rows.speaker: Giso
rows.body: Once our Hau Dragon's final plan begins, this whole world will become the realm of the dead anyway. It's just a matter of sooner or later.
lines: Giso「Once our Hau Dragon's final plan begins, this
whole world will become the realm of the dead
anyway. It's just a matter of sooner or later.」

rows.speaker: Masato
rows.body: Why do you hate Masaki Kihara!? Because he betrayed Hau Dragon!?
lines: Masato「Why do you hate Masaki Kihara!? Because
he betrayed Hau Dragon!?」

rows.speaker: Ritsu
rows.body: That's right! That woman is now being held captive inside Hau Dragon's fortress!
lines: Ritsu「That's right! That woman is now being held
captive inside Hau Dragon's fortress!」

rows.speaker: Yuratei
rows.body: All shall perish except the chosen people of Hau Dragon, and I shall become the Lord of Hades!
lines: Yuratei「All shall perish except the chosen people of
Hau Dragon, and I shall become the Lord of Hades!」

rows.speaker: Member A
rows.body: ...Hau Dragon seems to have entered the final phase of that plan.
lines: Member A「...Hau Dragon seems to have entered the
final phase of that plan.」

rows.speaker: Saiga
rows.body: Perhaps it's heading straight for the Hau Dragon fortress.
lines: Saiga「Perhaps it's heading straight for the Hau
Dragon fortress.」

rows.speaker: Burai
rows.body: But our situation is no different. Hau Dragon has fallen, but a new organization called Gyandlar has begun to act.
lines: Burai「But our situation is no different. Hau Dragon
has fallen, but a new organization called Gyandlar
has begun to act.」

rows.speaker: Hokushin
rows.body: Earthlings seem terribly fond of tampering with genes. ...Like the now-extinct Hau Dragon.
lines: Hokushin「Earthlings seem terribly fond of tampering
with genes. ...Like the now-extinct Hau Dragon.」

rows.speaker: Fuyutsuki
rows.body: The old men had a hand in founding Hau Dragon... It's possible.
lines: Fuyutsuki「The old men had a hand in founding Hau
Dragon... It's possible.」

rows.speaker: Hokushin's Six
rows.body: We cannot allow them to approach the Hau Dragon fortress.
lines: Hokushin's Six「We cannot allow them to approach
the Hau Dragon fortress.」

rows.speaker: Oki
rows.body: ... You have a transmission from Yuratei, the leader of Hau Dragon... No, the Iron Dragon...
lines: Oki「... You have a transmission from Yuratei, the
leader of Hau Dragon... No, the Iron Dragon...」

rows.speaker: Miku
rows.body: ... The Hau Dragon fortress's location... is stored in my memory. By following it, we should be able to jump there.
lines: Miku「... The Hau Dragon fortress's location... is
stored in my memory. By following it, we should be
able to jump there.」

rows.speaker: Masato
rows.body: Do you mean the fortress that descended onto the former site of Hau Dragon headquarters...?
lines: Masato「Do you mean the fortress that descended
onto the former site of Hau Dragon
headquarters...?」
